text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aah, the sun's so bright… Just look at that clear, blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's as if nature's sending me a sign that victory is in store for me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? You okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You look like you've been standing outside the hotel room of your trainee, hopelessly yelling for her to wake up.
choice_data_list: That's exactly what I've been doing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha! My bad. But it's thanks to you that I'm feeling so good!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Seeing my trainer before a race is part of my routine. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Shall we then? Off to Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: The Derby was incredible! Special Week's energy was so intense. She's the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky is pretty tough, but only the best can win the Kikuka Sho. Go get 'em, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow! Thank you for your support, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't let you down! I'm gonna win this!
Wooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, lookie here, today's main act has arrived! And who else would it be other than Spe herself?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: King? You look kinda tense…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Why wouldn't I be tense?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is the final crown we're racing for. I'll do whatever it takes to make it mine!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gee, she's taking this pretty seriously. Well, I guess that's the norm for her…

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What do we have here? Are you by chance a fan of mine?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Not the smartest little cookie, are you? I suggest you root for Spe, no questions asked. It isn't too late to switch sides, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um, that's…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is a hard race. That's why they say only the very best Umamusume win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It only makes sense that you root for Spe! Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Well… I guess so…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ That's what I thought. Now go ahead and focus on Spe now. That way…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I can do my thing and smash your expectations. ♪ Man, it's gonna feel so good!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: …Oh! Uh, o-okay!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: With that done, my trap is laid. All that's left is to run.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho… is mine.
